_info: Generazioni Scenario del prototipo, fatte dal server MCP di Scenario con il login dell'utente. Per rifarle: stesso model_id e stessi parameters con model_run (team e progetto in 'workspace'). I costi sono in Creative Units (CU), stimati con dry_run. Esiti: 'chosen_asset' è la variante scelta (provvisoria, da approvare dall'art director), 'other_assets' le altre; i file grezzi sono in source_assets/ai_raw/scenario/<batch>/.

parameters.prompt: stylized cartoon office carpet tiles, short low-pile commercial carpet in muted blue-grey with subtle darker speckles, soft hand-painted look, flat even lighting, no shadows, top-down view
stylized cartoon office wall, smooth warm cream painted plaster with a very subtle paint roller texture, soft hand-painted look, flat even lighting, no shadows, front view

batches.prompt_template: Flat cartoon game UI icon of {soggetto}. Thick dark outline, saturated colors, simple rounded shapes, single object centered, no text, readable at 64 pixels.

items.soggetto: a chunky battery with a lightning bolt and a bright green charge level
a round pressure gauge with the needle deep in the red zone and small puffs of steam
a white office coffee mug full of coffee with curling steam
a yellow paper folder stuffed with documents and a red urgent stamp mark without any letters
